NOTE
**Still not ready — fix-up commits need squashing**

New: The author fixed the icon alignment and pushed 3 new commits (alignment, a prettier fix, a 1px nudge), and says the screenshots are updated. Missing: the three follow-up commits should be squashed into the original commit, and the checklist items on testing, corner cases and responsiveness are still unchecked.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; laurynmm, who asked about the alignment, can check the new screenshots once the commits are cleaned up.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for fixing the alignment! Please squash the alignment, prettier and 1px-nudge commits into the original commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html), and finish the remaining self-review checklist items. Then ping @laurynmm to take another look.
```
